About

A closer look at my background, how I work, and the results I deliver.

Cloud Security and IAM Engineer with 4+ years of experience in enterprise security delivery, identity and access management, and cloud infrastructure automation. At Accenture I automated access provisioning and identity governance with Entra ID and PowerShell, and implemented RBAC/ABAC and SSO across cloud environments.
